title: 第484章 人鱼之歌为林默而谱第483章 屠杀神明
slug: 我妈等着治病你召唤我当勇者
content_zh:
第484章人鱼之歌为林默而谱
陷阱启动，数百种法则游龙从地面钻出向着林默冲击而来。
火焰、冰封、雷霆、岩石……
这些不是单纯的元素，而是法则之力凝聚出的生物。
但林默自始至终眼神都没有半分挪动。
他在这些法则游龙的包围下继续前进，任由他们冲向自己。
他们撞击在林默身上瞬间产生了剧烈的爆炸，各种元素冲天而起。
而陷阱又将爆炸之后余波锁在陷阱内部，一点能量也不浪费。
其他人只能看到一个直径不足三米的光柱冲天而起，光柱的耀眼程度让太阳都失色，整个天地仿佛都黯淡了几分。
那个布置陷阱的神明见状终于笑出了声：“哈哈！让你装逼！这下知道神明的厉害了吧。”
剩余的神明也都松了口气。
“终……终于解决了么。”
“哈哈，我还以为多牛逼呢，原来就这？”
“有一说一这家伙确实古怪。”
“古怪有个屁用！咱们是神明，是不死的，这就是得罪咱们的下场。”
……
随后就是神明的一阵狂笑。
而就在这时。
“嗯，不错的手段。”
所有神明同时闭上了嘴。

那道光柱还在燃烧，火焰、冰霜、雷霆、岩石的法则余波还在陷阱内部疯狂肆虐。
但所有神明的目光都死死盯着光柱正中央，一道人影正在从光柱中缓步走出。
他的黑袍被法则爆炸撕出了几道裂口，肩头的布料还在冒着几缕细烟。
但他的步伐依旧不紧不慢，靴底踩在碎裂的石板地上发出清脆的嗒嗒声，和之前走进陷阱时完全一致。
“这……怎么可能……”
布置陷阱的神明瞪大了双眼，他伸出一根颤抖的手指指向那道从光柱中走出的黑影，嘴唇剧烈翕动却只能挤出几个破碎的音节。
他的陷阱，他从成神那天起就开始钻研、花了数千年反复打磨、融入了数百种法则的终极陷阱阵。
能把所有爆炸能量锁死在陷阱内部反复冲击绝不浪费一丝一毫的完美陷阱，连那些高级神明的防御都能炸穿。
对眼前这个人类竟然无效。
“这一招在我所见过的攻击手段中，我愿称你为最强。”
声音落下的同时，那道黑影从光柱中穿过。
其他神明甚至没有看清发生了什么。
陷阱的法则光芒还在他们视网膜上残留着灼热的残影，耳边还回荡着爆炸的余响。
陷阱之神已经被林默单手捏着脖子提在半空中。
他的双腿徒劳地蹬了两下便软塌塌地垂了下来，双手无力地扒着林默的手指想掰开却纹丝不动。

content_en:
Chapter 484 The Mermaid Song was composed for Lin Mo
The trap was activated, and hundreds of law dragons emerged from the ground and charged towards Lin Mo.
Fire, ice, thunder, rock...
These are not simple elements, but creatures condensed by the power of law.
But Lin Mo's eyes didn't move at all from beginning to end.
He continued to move forward surrounded by these law dragons, letting them rush towards him.
When they hit Lin Mo, there was an instant violent explosion, and various elements shot into the sky.
The trap locks the aftermath of the explosion inside the trap, so no energy is wasted.
Others could only see a light pillar with a diameter of less than three meters rising into the sky. The light pillar was so dazzling that it eclipsed the sun, and the entire world seemed to be dimmed.
The god who laid the trap finally laughed out loud when he saw this: "Haha! Let you show off! Now you know how powerful the god is."
The remaining gods also breathed a sigh of relief.
"Finally...is it finally solved?"
"Haha, I thought you were so awesome, but this is it?"
"There is a saying that this guy is really weird."
"There's no point in being weird! We are gods and immortal. This is the result of offending us."
…
Then there was a burst of laughter from the gods.
And just then.
"Well, that's a good idea."
All the gods closed their mouths at the same time.
The beam of light is still burning, and the aftermath of the laws of flame, frost, thunder, and rock are still raging crazily inside the trap.
But all the gods' eyes were fixed on the center of the light pillar, where a figure was slowly walking out of the light pillar.
His black robe was torn apart by the law explosion, and the fabric on his shoulders was still emitting a few wisps of thin smoke.
But his pace was still unhurried, and the soles of his boots made a clear clicking sound on the broken stone floor, exactly the same as when he walked into the trap before.
"This...how is it possible..."
The god who laid the trap widened his eyes. He stretched out a trembling finger and pointed at the black shadow that came out of the light beam. His lips moved violently but he could only squeeze out a few broken syllables.
His trap was the ultimate trap array that he had studied since the day he became a god, spent thousands of years polishing it, and incorporated hundreds of laws.
A perfect trap that can lock all the explosive energy inside the trap and repeatedly impact it without wasting a single bit. It can even penetrate the defenses of those high-level gods.
It was ineffective against the human being in front of me.
"Among all the attack methods I have ever seen, I would like to call you the strongest."
As the voice fell, the black shadow passed through the light pillar.
The other gods didn't even see what was happening.
The lawful light of the trap still left a scorching afterimage on their retinas, and the reverberations of the explosion still echoed in their ears.
The God of Traps has been held in mid-air by Lin Mo holding his neck with one hand.
His legs kicked in vain twice before hanging down limply. His hands weakly grasped Lin Mo's fingers and tried to pry them apart, but they didn't move at all.
